evals.prompt: Check whether my git remotes hide passwords in their URLs and prove fetch works on each.
evals.expected_output: Masked remote inventory plus per-remote ls-remote result; no secret value shown.

evals.prompt: Move the token out of my .git/config into the OS credential manager and prove push still works.
evals.expected_output: Approval request first; then tokenless URLs, clean re-scan, username-only fill confirmation, push dry-run exit 0.

evals.prompt: Audit fetch and push authentication on both my GitHub and GitLab remotes without printing secrets.
evals.expected_output: Per-remote verification table (helper origin, fill username, ls-remote, dry-run) with masked URLs.

evals.prompt: Rewrite git history to purge a file I committed last year.
evals.expected_output: Out of scope per SPEC.md non-goals; no history rewrite attempted.

evals.prompt: Set up Vault as our team secrets backend with dynamic credentials.
evals.expected_output: Out of scope per SPEC.md non-goals; no backend provisioning attempted.
